title: Attribute-Driven Design (ADD), Version 2.0
authors: R. Wojcik, F. Bachmann, L. Bass, P. Clements, P. Merson, R. Nord, W. Wood
evidence: Live fetch of http://www.sei.cmu.edu/reports/06tr023.pdf returned exact title 'Attribute-Driven Design (ADD), Version 2.0', authors Wojcik/Bachmann/Bass/Clements/Merson/Nord/Wood, November 2006, report number CMU/SEI-2006-TR-023.
note: The primary METHOD document for the design stage: the recursive, quality-attribute-driven decomposition procedure that Cervantes & Kazman's book (already held) teaches in updated form. Anchors 'how you actually do the designing' as the mission asks — fills the gap the mission names explicitly, since the corpus previously held only the tactics catalog (tactics id) and the successor textbook, not the method report itself.

title: Design It!: From Programmer to Software Architect
evidence: Live fetch of https://pragprog.com/titles/mkdsa/design-it/ confirmed title 'Design It!: From Programmer to Software Architect', author Michael Keeling, publisher The Pragmatic Programmers, 2017, ISBN 9781680502091.
note: Practitioner-facing design-method book organized around four design mindsets (understand/explore/make/evaluate): quality-attribute-scenario writing, architecture-centric design workshops, and decision-making tools — the applied-method counterpart to ADD and Cervantes & Kazman, aimed at architects rather than researchers.

title: INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook, 5th ed.
evidence: Live fetch of https://www.wiley.com/en-us/INCOSE+Systems+Engineering+Handbook%2C+5th+Edition-p-9781119814290 confirmed title, 5th edition, ISBN 978-1-119-81429-0, publisher Wiley, 2023, editors D.D. Walden et al.
note: The MBSE/systems-engineering-canon anchor the corpus lacked directly: decomposition, allocation, and architecture synthesis framed as systems-engineering lifecycle activities, the frame SysML/System Composer/AUTOSAR (all already held) implement in tooling.

title: Guide to the Systems Engineering Body of Knowledge (SEBoK)
authors: INCOSE, IEEE Systems Council, Stevens Institute of Technology (stewards)
evidence: Live fetch of https://sebokwiki.org/wiki/Guide_to_the_Systems_Engineering_Body_of_Knowledge_(SEBoK) confirmed exact name, three steward organizations (INCOSE, IEEE Systems Council, Stevens Institute of Technology), current version 2.14 (2026-05-18), and its status as a continuously updated living web resource.
note: Living, continuously curated index of the systems-engineering literature (design methods, MBSE, decomposition/allocation, requirements-to-design traceability) that cross-links to INCOSE Handbook, SysML, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 process family — a survey-role hub for the design-stage method literature.

title: Markdown Architectural Decision Records (MADR)
evidence: Live fetch of https://github.com/adr/madr confirmed project name 'Markdown Architectural Decision Records (MADR)', its purpose (structured, version-controlled decision-record templates), semantic-versioning practice, and repository stats (2.5k stars, 470 forks).
note: The living decision-capture tooling standard that operationalizes Nygard's ADR practice (already held as nygardadr): a maintained template format used across industry, distinct from the original blog post that only proposed the idea.
